dataList.content:
So I will heal this dying mankind—a therapy for the fading souls.
我要治疗正在消亡的人类与正在消逝的灵魂。

I know that not everyone will approve of my way of doing things. Some will hold different perspectives and values that are against the new laws and world I intend to usher in.
我的方式无法让所有人感到满意。那些价值观与我不同的人们，会对我们将要带来的法则与世界心怀不满。
But... I want this. This is what I want. 但……我愿意这么做。这就是我想做的事。

Yes, I will shine all the same. I will give them warmth. Even if it ends up being unfair to some.
即便这对某些人不公平，但我还是要发光发热。

With this power, with this plan of mine.
以我自己的力量，以我自己的计划。
